name: Soul Of Envy
subtitle: Soul Card
body: The first time a player controls their 3rd soul, the active player chooses a player who controls the fewest souls or tied for fewest. That player gains this soul.

name: Soul Of Gluttony
subtitle: Soul Card
body: The first player to have 10 or more loot cards in their hand gains this soul.

name: Soul Of Greed
subtitle: Soul Card
body: The first player to have 25¢ or more gains this soul.

name: Soul Of Guppy
subtitle: Soul Card
body: The first player to control 2 or more guppy items gains this soul.

name: Soul Of Lust
subtitle: Soul Card
body: Each time a player kills a monster, put a counter on this. When the 6th counter is put on this, the active player gains this soul.

name: Soul Of Pride
subtitle: Soul Card
body: Each time a player gains a treasure, put a counter on this. When the 6th counter is put on this, the active player gains this soul.

name: Soul Of Sloth
subtitle: Soul Card
body: The first time a player controls 4 items, the active player chooses a player who controls the fewest items or tied for fewest. That player gains this soul.

name: Soul Of Wrath
subtitle: Soul Card
body: Each time a player dies, put a counter on this. When the 6th counter is put on this, the active player gains this soul.
